summary: 1099 W-9 compliance (Issue #14): vendors gain a stored tax_reporting_status (unknown|reportable|exempt_verified) with exemption basis, source, proof document, verified by/at and note, plus is_medical_provider. An exemption requires its provenance (CHECK). A trigger audits every change to these fields into new vendor_tax_status_events. Every existing vendor starts 'unknown'; no exemption is backfilled.

preflight.name: vendors has no tax_reporting_status column yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendors' AND column_name IN ('tax_reporting_status', 'tax_exemption_basis', 'is_medical_provider')

preflight.name: vendor_tax_status_events does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendor_tax_status_events'

expected_changes: Adds vendors.tax_reporting_status (NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown'), tax_exemption_basis, tax_exemption_source, tax_exemption_document_id (FK vendor_documents, RESTRICT), tax_exemption_verified_by, tax_exemption_verified_at, tax_exemption_note, is_medical_provider (NOT NULL DEFAULT false).
Adds CHECKs on status, basis and source values, and vendors_tax_exempt_provenance (exempt_verified requires basis + source + verified_by + verified_at).
Creates vendor_tax_status_events (append-only audit) with an index and service_role/authenticated grants.
Creates function vendor_tax_status_audit() and trigger trg_vendor_tax_status_audit (AFTER UPDATE ON vendors) that records before/after of the tax fields when they change.
No existing vendor value changes; existing vendors read as 'unknown' (potentially reportable).

verify.name: every existing vendor is 'unknown' and not a medical provider
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendors WHERE tax_reporting_status <> 'unknown' OR is_medical_provider

verify.name: audit trigger present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_vendor_tax_status_audit'

verify.name: no audit events created by the migration itself
